text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"...
Trainer, let's see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'll show "that Umamusume" what it looks like
to run freely, even under pressure!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here they are, the Umamusume running today.
Mejiro Ryan. And though frail, running with resolute grace,
the glass-hearted lady, Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume representing the Mejiro family.
And today, there are other noteworthy Umamusume to keep an eye on as well.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Yes, that star horse girl who defined an entire era!"
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap! It's Oguri Cap!
She's been in an uncharacteristic slump over her last few races,
but what kind of performance will she show us today!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Please, we're begging you, Oguri...
Our idol...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't push yourself any harder...
Just get some proper rest, okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... What is this?
A total jumble of MAX expectation and MAX sympathy~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just hearing about it sounds exhausting...
Running while getting this much attention, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it definitely won't be easy.
Yeah, that's definitely no small feat.

text_block_list.text:
As if the entire nation's eyes were fixed on it.
A special race, like a singularity in Umamusume history.

"Not only was she far from peak condition, but the pressure was tremendous.
Yet, despite all those handicaps—Oguri Cap pushed through and prevailed."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Oguri Cap!
Oguri! Oguri! Oguriiiii!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A glorious comeback at the Arima Kinen!
A true miracle! A dramatic victory!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, thank you for the dream!
Thank you for moving our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way... I won... I actually won...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In a tough spot like this... Whaaaaat!?
Are you... serious...?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: O-G-RI! O-G-RI!
What lay there was—

The absolute gold standard. The image of a super
horse girl shattering all common sense.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Um, Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There's something I want to ask! Bearing this much pressure, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you get stiff or scared at all?
You didn't really seem to be feeling the pressure either.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Pressure? Yeah, I guess...
I always feel the expectations. But...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know about getting stiff...
I don't have the luxury to get that way to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I have no choice but to answer their expectations,
and what's more, I always want to."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Living up to the hopes of those who place their dreams in me—
that is the only reason I race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Living up to... their dreams...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I see... There really are Umamusume who can take
that crazy amount of pressure and convert it entirely into power.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap... So this is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So running freely is what it means...

It was a major learning experience. And so,
each of the Umamusume took their newfound challenges to heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, second place, huh. I couldn't
reach Oguri-san... Somehow, I have to unlock my full potential!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I failed to live up to expectations. Even though Oguri-san
won in the same bracket. It's proof that my resolve
is still nowhere near enough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I see, we're the same...
Though our levels might be different...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is carrying something.
Even so, reaching out with all their might—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, watching today's race made me realize...
I still have a long way to go after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Still, I get it now! There's not a single girl in the Twinkle Series who isn't carrying something on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the only one struggling.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'll gain even more strength to overcome the pressure!
Just like Oguri Cap.
